_comment: Maps legacy AWS Config managed-rule SourceIdentifier values to their canonical forms. AWS has renamed several rules over time but older conformance pack templates still reference the legacy identifier; without this remap, validate_yaml.py rejects these as 'not in managed-rules.txt'. Refresh: run scripts/refresh_managed_rules.py, then diff every conformance pack's SourceIdentifier against the snapshot and add a remap entry for each unmapped identifier where AWS publishes the canonical form in the Config developer guide.
_provenance: manual-human (curated from AWS Config developer guide rename history)
